accepted_claims: Equal-size balanced V-poset extension classes can have an unbalanced abstract uniform union.
A twelve-label abstract prefix-set system has exactly seven full maximal chains and all minority probabilities at most 2/7.
The fully indexed binary-symmetric Cauchy–Binet endpoint-replacement determinant identity is valid.
An instructional root with consecutive entries 1 on an eleven-position interval cannot admit endpoint exchanges at offsets (0,6),(2,8),(4,10).
The exact seven-word generic path language cannot be realized by a symmetric binary matrix.
original_scope_acceptance.matrix_scope: Nonsingular symmetric F2 matrices with a full-length successful permutation; local proposition requires the stated consecutive-entry hypothesis only inside its eleven-position interval.
original_scope_acceptance.mixture_scope: Countermodel to the listed abstract mixing conditions only; no complete maximal-chain or pressing realization claimed.
original_scope_acceptance.generic_scope: Exact abstract maximal-chain language; proved NOT to be a pressing language. No identification with all nonsingular principal subsets.
nonblocking_editorial_qualifications: Only nonempty insertion fibers are singletons; other indexed fibers can be empty.
Prefix-splicing phrase is accepted as exact maximal-chain language and splicing at a common prefix set, not as an undefined universal class of closure axioms.
original_scope_acceptance.private_code_and_raw_outputs: Private audit support, not approved for publication by this audit.

edition_scope: Full separate authored proof and full substantive audit, with a meaningful complete-singleton-addition-path scope-precision correction, the nonblocking nonempty-fiber clarification, and unavailable-locator edits, all exactly mapped.
review_meaning: AI-assisted unrefereed mathematics. Independent internal AI audit is not external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof certification, or priority clearance. The historical audit heading Human proof denotes an explicit algebraic proof, not human authorship or human review.
fresh_public_edition_review: Required separately; not asserted by this scope acceptance.
excludes: Programs, raw automaton certificate, raw execution outputs, datasets and dataset contents, copied source documents or text, private sources, personal data, and coordination material.
distribution_limit: No executable public replay package. Public numerical records are curated aggregate verification metadata, not copied raw output files.
edition_terminology: Any historical maximal-chain wording in original_scope_acceptance is interpreted as the exact family of complete singleton-addition chains from empty to full, and hence closure under every splice at a common prefix set. No assertion is made about arbitrary maximal chains of the inclusion poset being rank-complete. Every feasible set lying on a full path is not offered as a proof of such an assertion.

meaningful_scope_precision_correction.claim: The constructed language is exactly the complete singleton-addition chains from empty to full, and is closed under every splice at a common prefix set.
meaningful_scope_precision_correction.not_claimed: Arbitrary inclusion-poset maximal chains need not be rank-complete; no such completeness assertion follows merely because every feasible set lies on a full path.
meaningful_scope_precision_correction.historical_acceptance_note: original_scope_acceptance is preserved verbatim as historical metadata. Its mathematical_corrections_required=false and nonblocking wording classification are not represented as a current conclusion about the broader inclusion-poset interpretation. This edition expressly corrects that scope ambiguity and the unsupported audit inference.
meaningful_scope_precision_correction.proof_arguments: Unchanged for the intended complete-singleton-addition path result and every other accepted result.
